blocks.text: Open Desktop Appearance from Computer Management → Devices & Desktop or the system settings menu. The editor reads the current installed native configuration files and exposes supported fields. Search within the editor to locate settings.

Review your selected values before applying. User configuration changes and any greeter/system changes have separate authority requirements. Administrative operations require the existing authentication flow; Help never requests that authority.

Reset and preset data comes from the installed managed catalog, not from a source checkout. User settings include ~/.config/labwc, waybar, fuzzel, mako and terminal configuration. If a component does not refresh immediately, save your work and follow its specific refresh/restart action.
Do not delete your entire ~/.config directory to reset appearance. Preserve a backup of the affected file and restore only that component.
